volume.method: band midpoints of Impressions shown per book-month (Google bulk/country windows per creative) + live-creative counts per book-month; bands stay bands

demand_sensitivity.method: brand-FE panel on log spend/volume vs same-market ruler+outcome series (intra = peer gambling spend/impressions; extra = ruler series + seasonality + political cycle). Correlational wording mandatory; estimator not run this pass

efficiency.method: vendor-rated cost-per-1k + ROAS bands (vendor_model, never implied true advertiser ROAS) paired with official outcomes (UKGC GGY etc) for disclosed efficiency-proxy context

_meta.currency_note: currencies/units pinned per-row by their lane; ad-library monetary integers are minor units
_meta.coverage_note: Google bulk = EEA coverage only (documented 0 GB rows); Google RPC = GLOBAL cohorts, no country scoping; Meta = GB view modal cohorts + GB card adcounts; TikTok = vendor-model dollars, no disclosed impressions
